name: Avocado and poached egg on toast

ingredients.display: a few slices of red chilli

steps: Scoop the avocado into a bowl, mash roughly with the lemon juice, salt and pepper, keeping some texture.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes while the sourdough toasts.
Spread the avocado thickly over the toast, sit a drained egg on each slice and finish with the chilli and a grind of pepper.

name: Boiled eggs with toast soldiers
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water on a spoon and set a timer for 6 minutes for a runny yolk, 7 for jammy.
Toast the bread, butter it and cut into thick fingers.
Sit the eggs in egg cups, slice the tops off and season the yolks before dipping.

name: Cheese and mushroom omelette
steps: Fry the mushrooms in half the butter over a high heat until browned and any liquid has cooked off, then tip onto a plate.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper. Melt the rest of the butter in the pan over a medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Draw the setting edges into the middle, tilting the pan so raw egg runs out. When just set on top, scatter the mushrooms and cheese over one half.
Fold the omelette over the filling, leave for 30 seconds to melt the cheese, then slide onto a plate.

name: Eggs Benedict

ingredients.display: 2 eggs to poach, plus 1 yolk for the sauce

steps: Whisk the egg yolk with the lemon juice in a bowl over barely simmering water, then trickle in the warm melted butter, whisking, until the hollandaise thickens. Season and keep warm off the heat.
Poach the two eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, then lift out and drain on kitchen paper.
Toast the muffin halves and warm the ham briefly in a dry pan.
Sit the ham on the muffin halves, top each with a poached egg and spoon over the hollandaise.

name: Eggy bread
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk, cinnamon and a pinch of salt in a wide shallow dish.
Soak each slice of bread for about 20 seconds a side until saturated but not falling apart.
Fry in foaming butter over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes a side until golden and puffed. Serve hot, cut into triangles.

name: Fried egg on toast
steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and crack in the eggs.
Fry for 2-3 minutes, spooning the hot oil over the whites, until the whites are set and the edges are lacy.
Toast and butter the bread, slide the eggs on top and season with salt and pepper.

name: Poached eggs on toast
steps: Bring a deep pan of water to a bare simmer and add a splash of vinegar. Crack each egg into a cup first.
Stir the water into a slow whirlpool, slide the eggs in and poach for 3 minutes for a runny yolk.
Toast and butter the bread. Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon, drain on kitchen paper and sit them on the toast with salt and pepper.

name: Scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and a good pinch of salt. Put the bread on to toast.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a low heat, pour in the eggs and leave for 20 seconds before stirring.
Keep folding the eggs slowly, pulling the set curds to the middle. Take the pan off the heat while they still look slightly underdone and pile onto the toast.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the olive oil in a small frying pan for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin, paprika and harissa and fry for a minute.
Tip in the tomatoes, season and simmer for 8-10 minutes until thick enough to hold a channel when you drag a spoon through.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover the pan and cook for 4-5 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Serve straight from the pan with the sourdough for mopping.

name: Smoked salmon and scrambled eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and pepper. Go easy on the salt, the salmon brings plenty.
Scramble slowly in the butter over a low heat, stirring constantly, and take them off while still glossy and soft.
Pile onto the toasted sourdough, drape the smoked salmon over and finish with lemon and black pepper.
